title: 19th Sitting of second session of 2026

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/19/2/2026).

Question from Kendhoo MP Mauroof Zakir to the Minister of Islamic Affairs and Endowments, Dr Mohamed Shaheem Ali Saeed: on 11 August 2025 the President told B. Kudarikilu residents a new mosque agreement was signed and work would start once land was allocated; land has been handed over but nothing has started, so when will it begin and finish?

Question from Kendhoo MP Mauroof Zakir to the Minister of Islamic Affairs and Endowments, Dr Mohamed Shaheem Ali Saeed: the ministry says a contractor has been assigned for the planned B. Kamadhoo mosque, yet no practical work is under way; what are the set start and completion dates?

Preliminary debate on the resolution by Hulhumale South MP Dr Ahmed Shamheed calling on the government to immediately halt the sale of permanent residence permits to foreigners under the "Maldives Pearl Residence Programme" and disclose all related agreements to Parliament.
Unfinished business: continued debate on the Bill on Leasing Uninhabited Islands and Lagoons, submitted on behalf of the government by Thinadhoo North MP Saudhulla Hilmy.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting questioned the Islamic affairs minister on two Baa atoll mosques, opened debate on the Pearl Residence Programme resolution, and continued the island-leasing bill debate.
